newsitem.title: USA: No plans to return to talks with Teamsters-UPS CEO.
newsitem.headline: No plans to return to talks with Teamsters-UPS CEO.

text.p: United Parcel Service has no plans for now to return to the bargaining table to resume contract talks with the striking Teamsters union, UPS Chief Executive Officer James Kelly said Tuesday.
"At this point in time there are no meetings scheduled," Kelly said in an interview with cable television network CNBC.
Kelly said he spoke with Labour Secretary Alexis Herman earlier Tuesday. Herman is trying to get both sides in the dispute to resume face-to-face talks after negotiations broke off on Saturday.
"I expect that we'll be hearing from her later today. But at this moment in time there are no plans to go back," Kelley said.
Herman met with both sides separately on Monday but failed to get them to agree to return to the bargaining table.
Teamsters President Ron Carey told reporters after his meeting with Herman on Monday that he was ready to go back to the bargaining table, but only for serious negotiations.
